video_title: RJ REACTS to Austin Reaves Becoming The Richest Undrafted Player EVER

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves' usage rate and physical toll on his game
quotes.excerpt: the last three years as his usage rate has gone up, his game plays has gone down

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: The last three years as his usage rate has gone up, his game plays has gone down. The number of games that he's played has gone down the last three years.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: Which is such an interesting thing because every year his numbers have gone up too.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: The usage has gone up, the games has gone down. Do you see how much it can wear people out? Some guys are physically gifted. Some guys work their tail off and are extremely skilled. Some guys push themselves to the limit. Austin Reaves is outstanding, deserves every dollar, but I think when you see the game plays, the numbers going up, I'd rather have less numbers, more games played.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Impact of heavy usage on LeBron James and Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: there's a difference between a monster for 82 games and a guy that might has to do it

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: How much does that, do you factor in, for example, you could just look at last season in general, the totality of games missed for LeBron at the start of the season, so him and Luka, and then Luka goes out and what he had to shoulder, which all three of them had to do at some point throughout the course of last season?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I 100% agree. I think that that has had an impact on them. But that also shows there's a difference between a monster for 82 games and a guy that might has to do it for 35 because he's got teammates around him. I love Austin. I think he's worth every single dollar. I think the Lakers did an outstanding deal by him, but you also have to find a way, if I see a player and I sign him to the biggest deal for a player in his position, but the last three years his games have gone down, that's something that internally we want to try and address.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' roster construction and interest in Jaylen Durren
quotes.excerpt: Do you guys like a move like Jaylen Durren?

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: What does that look like for the roster construction? Do you guys like a move like Jaylen Durren?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Yes, if they can get him. If you can get him, yes. Also, can I ask a question, when is Austin trade available? It would be December, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: The Lakers just signed him, you're already trading him?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: No, no, no, no. But listen, you're available. I think you can sign a player but you can't trade him till like December or something like that. Something along those lines.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers need for defensive support around Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: the Lakers deserve a guy who's also going to help them try and win a chip

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: That's a wonderful contract, but it's also a very movable contract if it's not working. Austin Reaves deserves his money, but if we talk about the Lakers, the Lakers deserve a guy who's also going to help them try and win a chip when you have Luka Doncic. And so if his appeal equals two or three guys that can do not only his job but defensively, and maybe somebody off the bench, you're telling me that Rob Pelinka won't do that? That's just how the league is.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: I'm looking back at you. You know Rob Pelinka, he was your agent.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Yeah, and listen, Rob got me traded a couple times. He was like, yo, take the bag and then I'll trade you. And then we'll get you traded. I took the bag to go to Orlando. I was bought in on the young guys stuff. When I got there, he was like, yeah, yeah, it's time to get you out of there. This is a lot of dysfunction. I took the money. You got to take the money.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Risks of signing restricted free agents like Jaylen Durren
quotes.excerpt: if you're a restricted free agent, you know what that means. That means that you can make a bid

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: The Jaylen Durren thing, I love a target, but if you're a restricted free agent, you know what that means. That means that you can make a bid on a player, but you better have a backup plan. You better have a backup plan. Detroit was a number, and Jaylen Durren had an okay postseason, but I'm going to look at a body of work. Austin Reaves played 50 games, but I'm going to look at a body of work and pay him 185 million. Jaylen Durren, I'm going to look at a body of work, not just how you played in the postseason. Detroit ain't going to just let him walk. And they have the ability to match any offer that's put out there.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: Is there anyone else top of mind at the center position?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Dallas. Dallas got two dudes, a little older. Well, one's younger injury and then the other one's older. I got, why did I forget their names?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Daniel Gafford and Lively. I see what Daniel Gafford, what you need for Daniel Gafford. That's a legit, that's a A-list. You just have to have a backup plan.
